profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @  Apple | Vue.js, React, Typescript, Go
profile.summary:
I develop solutions to make others’ lives a little bit better everyday. I am passionate about data analysis, automation, and user experience, and I use my skills in Vue.js, React, Node.js, and Go to create innovative products and features. 

I graduated from Hack Reactor, a top-rated software engineering bootcamp, in 2019, and from California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo, with a BS in Business Administration: Accounting and Information Systems, in 2017. I am always up for a challenge and an opportunity to grow, and I enjoy tinkering with Raspberry Pi projects in my spare time.

positions.title: Co-Creator / Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a multi-platform data analysis system for San Francisco Muni light-rail routes, utilizing live prediction data for delay calculations.
- Orchestrated a middle-tier server to optimize data access, diminishing reliance on the NextBus API.
- Ensured system scalability through Dockerized API/server architecture.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · React Native · Node.js

positions.title: Back End Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enforced high availability with Kubernetes, enabling automated failovers in under 30 seconds.
- Slashed request latency by an impressive 94% through horizontal scaling, replacing NGINX load-balancers with Kubernetes clusters.
- Boosted performance with a remarkable 400% surge in requests per second by modernizing the backend from Node.js to Go.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Node.js · New Relic

positions.title: IT Risk Assurance Auditor
positions.description:
- Spearheaded a project that automated report creation, reducing staff hours by 98%.
- Managed a team of three in the creation and monetization of multiple websites for testing the end-to-end ad serving pipeline.
- Designed an automated dashboard to track and assign testing of over 650 controls, enhancing accuracy and transparency.
- Conducted source code reviews to validate the effectiveness of critical processes, including continuous integration/deployment and access provisioning.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a full-stack web application to automate manual data collection and entry, minimizing clerical errors.
- Achieved a 95% reduction in online form submission time by implementing a MySQL database to store and retrieve prior year data.
- Successfully delivered the project on time and within budget by introducing Agile practices, including bi-weekly sprints, daily standups, and weekly burndown chart reviews, in collaboration with management.

positions.title: IT Risk Assurance Intern
positions.description:
External Audit:
- Conducted updates and executed audit procedures to evaluate the efficacy of more than 20 internal controls.
- Innovatively crafted Audit Procedure templates, utilized by the entire team for the year's audit.

Internal Audit:
- Successfully presented a cutting-edge Audit Software to client management, receiving positive feedback.
- Collaborated closely with the engagement team to analyze client data, generate reports, and display them on a client-facing Dashboard system.
- Acquired fundamental knowledge of engagement budgeting and scheduling from a senior manager, subsequently collaborating on team scheduling tasks.

positions.title: Accounting Intern
positions.description:
Accounts Payable:
- Efficiently received and documented bills/invoices within the Quickbooks database.
- Managed bill payments to diverse vendors via credit card and check.
- Produced weekly Accounts Payable reports for upper management.

Sales Reporting:
- Maintained accurate sales records for 5 stores using Quickbooks and Excel.
- Streamlined the sales spreadsheet system, reducing reporting time by 50% (from 30 to 15 minutes).
- Regularly compiled and generated daily sales reports for all 5 stores using Excel.

Labor Budgeting:
- Developed labor budgeting spreadsheets in Excel.
- Monitored daily labor as a percentage of sales to maintain the targeted margin.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
- Social Media: Managed Diddams' marketing social media presence, including advertising on the Diddams Facebook page.
- Graphic Design: Collaborated with customers to create and design banners, t-shirts, brochures, stickers, and more for events and holidays.
- Inventory Management: Effectively monitored and tracked the inventory of various products, initiating order requests as necessary.
- Framework Creation: Enhanced inventory tracking control by crafting a new, optimized inventory control spreadsheet tool.
- Product Placement: Contributed to product display and shelf placement strategies in multiple stores to attract a wider customer base.
